# Curated skills

Independent GitHub skill projects worth understanding before you install them.

Page: https://skills.lencx.me/collections/
Markdown: https://skills.lencx.me/collections/index.md

Understand what each project does, where it fits, and what to watch before you install it.

# Addy Osmani’s Agent Skills

A production-engineering lifecycle pack with explicit gates, anti-rationalization rules, specialist personas, and a staged brownfield adoption path.

Page: https://skills.lencx.me/collections/addy-agent-skills/
Markdown: https://skills.lencx.me/collections/addy-agent-skills/index.md

<div class="curated-detail curated-card--addy">
<div class="curated-detail__identity">
<span class="curated-card__avatar-frame" aria-hidden="true"><img class="curated-card__avatar curated-card__avatar--fallback" src="/github-placeholder.svg" alt="" width="96" height="96"><img class="curated-card__avatar curated-card__avatar--remote" data-github-avatar src="https://avatars.githubusercontent.com/u/110953?v=4&amp;s=96" alt="" width="96" height="96" loading="lazy" decoding="async" referrerpolicy="no-referrer"></span>
<div class="curated-detail__identity-copy">
<a class="curated-detail__repository" href="https://github.com/addyosmani/agent-skills" target="_blank" rel="noopener" aria-label="View GitHub repository: Addy Osmani’s Agent Skills">addyosmani/agent-skills</a>
<div class="curated-detail__tags" aria-label="Project tags"><a href="/collections/?tag=reference" title="Filter by tag: #Reference">#Reference</a><a href="/collections/?tag=engineering" title="Filter by tag: #Engineering">#Engineering</a><a href="/collections/?tag=quality" title="Filter by tag: #Quality">#Quality</a></div>
</div>
</div>
<dl class="curated-detail__stats" aria-label="GitHub snapshot">
<div><dt><svg class="curated-icon" aria-hidden="true" viewBox="0 0 24 24" data-icon="lucide:star"><path fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M11.525 2.295a.53.53 0 0 1 .95 0l2.31 4.679a2.12 2.12 0 0 0 1.595 1.16l5.166.756a.53.53 0 0 1 .294.904l-3.736 3.638a2.12 2.12 0 0 0-.611 1.878l.882 5.14a.53.53 0 0 1-.771.56l-4.618-2.428a2.12 2.12 0 0 0-1.973 0L6.396 21.01a.53.53 0 0 1-.77-.56l.881-5.139a2.12 2.12 0 0 0-.611-1.879L2.16 9.795a.53.53 0 0 1 .294-.906l5.165-.755a2.12 2.12 0 0 0 1.597-1.16z"/></svg><span>Stars</span></dt><dd title="86,280">86,280</dd></div>
<div><dt><svg class="curated-icon" aria-hidden="true" viewBox="0 0 24 24" data-icon="lucide:fork"><g fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2"><circle cx="12" cy="18" r="3"/><circle cx="6" cy="6" r="3"/><circle cx="18" cy="6" r="3"/><path d="M18 9v2c0 .6-.4 1-1 1H7c-.6 0-1-.4-1-1V9m6 3v3"/></g></svg><span>Forks</span></dt><dd title="9,269">9,269</dd></div>
</dl>
<a class="curated-detail__repo" href="https://github.com/addyosmani/agent-skills" target="_blank" rel="noopener"><svg class="curated-icon" aria-hidden="true" viewBox="0 0 24 24" data-icon="lucide:github"><g fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2"><path d="M15 22v-4a4.8 4.8 0 0 0-1-3.5c3.28-.36 6.72-1.61 6.72-7.25A5.65 5.65 0 0 0 19.22 3.3A5.27 5.27 0 0 0 19.08.32S17.9-.06 15 1.82a13.38 13.38 0 0 0-7 0C5.1-.06 3.92.32 3.92.32A5.27 5.27 0 0 0 3.78 3.3a5.65 5.65 0 0 0-1.5 3.95c0 5.64 3.44 6.89 6.72 7.25A4.8 4.8 0 0 0 8 18v4"/><path d="M9 18c-4.51 2-5-2-7-2"/></g></svg><span>View GitHub repository</span></a>
</div>
<p class="curated-detail__snapshot"><span>Analysis revision <code>be42637</code></span><span aria-hidden="true">·</span><span>GitHub snapshot Aug 12, 2026</span><span aria-hidden="true">·</span><span>Metrics are a dated GitHub snapshot and are not used as a quality score.</span></p>
<div class="curated-story">
<div class="curated-story__lede">
<p class="curated-story__thesis">Its distinguishing feature is not catalog size. Each workflow exposes likely agent rationalizations, red flags, and exit evidence, making engineering discipline inspectable instead of aspirational.</p>
<p>Commands map Define, Plan, Build, Verify, Review, and Ship onto focused Skills and specialist personas. using-agent-skills routes work and enforces assumptions, pushback, scope, and evidence. Individual Skills follow trigger → process → rationalizations → red flags → verification, while commands compose several disciplines without personas recursively invoking personas.</p>
</div>
<section class="curated-story__section curated-story__signature" aria-labelledby="signature-model">
<header class="curated-story__section-heading">
<h2 id="signature-model">Who decides when, how, and from which viewpoint</h2>
<p>The repository separates orchestration from reusable method and specialist judgment. That boundary makes a multi-agent review understandable and prevents personas from recursively creating hidden process.</p>
</header>
<div class="curated-signature curated-signature--responsibilities" data-story-kind="responsibilities">
<article class="curated-signature__item" style="--story-index:1"><span class="curated-signature__meta">When</span><h3>Command</h3><p>Maps lifecycle stages such as Define, Plan, Build, Verify, Review, and Ship onto several capabilities.</p></article><article class="curated-signature__item" style="--story-index:2"><span class="curated-signature__meta">How</span><h3>Skill</h3><p>Provides one reusable procedure with triggers, steps, rationalizations, red flags, and verification.</p></article><article class="curated-signature__item" style="--story-index:3"><span class="curated-signature__meta">Who</span><h3>Persona</h3><p>Supplies a specialist review perspective without recursively orchestrating more personas.</p></article>
</div>
<div class="curated-story__evidence"><span>Evidence</span><a href="https://github.com/addyosmani/agent-skills/blob/be42637c5af93fdc8526b68ec2f2651b930f316c/README.md" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Lifecycle and skill catalog<svg class="curated-icon" aria-hidden="true" viewBox="0 0 24 24" data-icon="lucide:external"><path fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M15 3h6v6m-11 5L21 3m-3 10v6a2 2 0 0 1-2 2H5a2 2 0 0 1-2-2V8a2 2 0 0 1 2-2h6"/></svg></a><a href="https://github.com/addyosmani/agent-skills/blob/be42637c5af93fdc8526b68ec2f2651b930f316c/docs/adoption-guide.md#L73-L128" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Brownfield adoption<svg class="curated-icon" aria-hidden="true" viewBox="0 0 24 24" data-icon="lucide:external"><path fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M15 3h6v6m-11 5L21 3m-3 10v6a2 2 0 0 1-2 2H5a2 2 0 0 1-2-2V8a2 2 0 0 1 2-2h6"/></svg></a><a href="https://github.com/addyosmani/agent-skills/blob/be42637c5af93fdc8526b68ec2f2651b930f316c/skills/doubt-driven-development/SKILL.md#L49-L181" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Doubt-driven review<svg class="curated-icon" aria-hidden="true" viewBox="0 0 24 24" data-icon="lucide:external"><path fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M15 3h6v6m-11 5L21 3m-3 10v6a2 2 0 0 1-2 2H5a2 2 0 0 1-2-2V8a2 2 0 0 1 2-2h6"/></svg></a></div>
</section>
<section class="curated-story__section" aria-labelledby="project-mechanisms">
<h2 id="project-mechanisms">Why the workflows are auditable</h2>
<div class="curated-story__mechanisms">
<article><h3>Auditable quality gates</h3><p>Mandatory steps, common excuses and rebuttals, red flags, and explicit exit evidence make each workflow reviewable rather than aspirational.</p></article><article><h3>Staged brownfield adoption</h3><p>Existing codebases start with context, read-only review, and targeted characterization tests instead of loading every Skill or attempting a big-bang rewrite.</p></article><article><h3>Independent doubt cycles</h3><p>Small high-stakes artifacts can be reviewed by a fresh context that receives only the artifact and contract, then reconciles findings against the source.</p></article>
</div>
</section>
<section class="curated-story__section" aria-labelledby="project-practice">
<h2 id="project-practice">Adopt the catalog in stages</h2>
<ol class="curated-story__practice">
<li><p>For an established codebase, begin with context engineering, read-only review, and characterization tests around the next change.</p></li><li><p>Load only Skills for the current phase; the repository explicitly discourages injecting the whole catalog into every session.</p></li><li><p>Use a direct persona for one specialist judgment and a command when several review disciplines need orchestration.</p></li>
</ol>
</section>
<section class="curated-story__section" aria-labelledby="adoption-decision">
<h2 id="adoption-decision">Use the lifecycle selectively, not all at once</h2>
<div class="curated-story__decision">
<div>
<h3>Strong fit for</h3>
<p>Production-oriented teams that want consistent specification, implementation, verification, review, and release gates across greenfield and brownfield codebases.</p>
</div>
<div>
<h3>Keep in scope</h3>
<p>The pack is deliberately prescriptive and phase-heavy. Per-Skill copies may omit shared root references, and host adapters do not provide identical commands, personas, hooks, or plugin behavior.</p>
</div>
</div>
</section>
<section class="curated-story__section curated-story__sources" aria-labelledby="reviewed-sources">
<h2 id="reviewed-sources">Sources reviewed</h2>

# Anthropic Agent Skills

Anthropic’s public examples and reference implementations for creative, technical, enterprise, and document workflows.

Page: https://skills.lencx.me/collections/anthropic-agent-skills/
Markdown: https://skills.lencx.me/collections/anthropic-agent-skills/index.md

<div class="curated-detail curated-card--anthropic">
<div class="curated-detail__identity">
<span class="curated-card__avatar-frame" aria-hidden="true"><img class="curated-card__avatar curated-card__avatar--fallback" src="/github-placeholder.svg" alt="" width="96" height="96"><img class="curated-card__avatar curated-card__avatar--remote" data-github-avatar src="https://avatars.githubusercontent.com/u/76263028?v=4&amp;s=96" alt="" width="96" height="96" loading="lazy" decoding="async" referrerpolicy="no-referrer"></span>
<div class="curated-detail__identity-copy">
<a class="curated-detail__repository" href="https://github.com/anthropics/skills" target="_blank" rel="noopener" aria-label="View GitHub repository: Anthropic Agent Skills">anthropics/skills</a>
<div class="curated-detail__tags" aria-label="Project tags"><a href="/collections/?tag=reference" title="Filter by tag: #Reference">#Reference</a><a href="/collections/?tag=quality" title="Filter by tag: #Quality">#Quality</a></div>
</div>
</div>
<dl class="curated-detail__stats" aria-label="GitHub snapshot">
<div><dt><svg class="curated-icon" aria-hidden="true" viewBox="0 0 24 24" data-icon="lucide:star"><path fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M11.525 2.295a.53.53 0 0 1 .95 0l2.31 4.679a2.12 2.12 0 0 0 1.595 1.16l5.166.756a.53.53 0 0 1 .294.904l-3.736 3.638a2.12 2.12 0 0 0-.611 1.878l.882 5.14a.53.53 0 0 1-.771.56l-4.618-2.428a2.12 2.12 0 0 0-1.973 0L6.396 21.01a.53.53 0 0 1-.77-.56l.881-5.139a2.12 2.12 0 0 0-.611-1.879L2.16 9.795a.53.53 0 0 1 .294-.906l5.165-.755a2.12 2.12 0 0 0 1.597-1.16z"/></svg><span>Stars</span></dt><dd title="168,206">168,206</dd></div>
<div><dt><svg class="curated-icon" aria-hidden="true" viewBox="0 0 24 24" data-icon="lucide:fork"><g fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2"><circle cx="12" cy="18" r="3"/><circle cx="6" cy="6" r="3"/><circle cx="18" cy="6" r="3"/><path d="M18 9v2c0 .6-.4 1-1 1H7c-.6 0-1-.4-1-1V9m6 3v3"/></g></svg><span>Forks</span></dt><dd title="20,038">20,038</dd></div>
</dl>
<a class="curated-detail__repo" href="https://github.com/anthropics/skills" target="_blank" rel="noopener"><svg class="curated-icon" aria-hidden="true" viewBox="0 0 24 24" data-icon="lucide:github"><g fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2"><path d="M15 22v-4a4.8 4.8 0 0 0-1-3.5c3.28-.36 6.72-1.61 6.72-7.25A5.65 5.65 0 0 0 19.22 3.3A5.27 5.27 0 0 0 19.08.32S17.9-.06 15 1.82a13.38 13.38 0 0 0-7 0C5.1-.06 3.92.32 3.92.32A5.27 5.27 0 0 0 3.78 3.3a5.65 5.65 0 0 0-1.5 3.95c0 5.64 3.44 6.89 6.72 7.25A4.8 4.8 0 0 0 8 18v4"/><path d="M9 18c-4.51 2-5-2-7-2"/></g></svg><span>View GitHub repository</span></a>
</div>
<p class="curated-detail__snapshot"><span>Analysis revision <code>f17010c</code></span><span aria-hidden="true">·</span><span>GitHub snapshot Aug 12, 2026</span><span aria-hidden="true">·</span><span>Metrics are a dated GitHub snapshot and are not used as a quality score.</span></p>
<div class="curated-story">
<div class="curated-story__lede">
<p class="curated-story__thesis">This is not a software-delivery operating system. Its value is showing, in first-party files, how a Skill is packaged, progressively loaded, and tested against a baseline.</p>
<p>Each Skill is an independently loadable directory. Its name and description stay visible for discovery, SKILL.md loads when triggered, and scripts, references, or assets are used only when needed. The bundled skill-creator then evaluates real prompts against a baseline, grades assertions and output quality, and iterates from human feedback.</p>
</div>
<section class="curated-story__section curated-story__signature" aria-labelledby="signature-model">
<header class="curated-story__section-heading">
<h2 id="signature-model">What enters context, and when</h2>
<p>The package shape is a context-budget contract. A useful Skill keeps discovery cheap, delays its procedure until it triggers, and defers heavy material until the task actually needs it.</p>
</header>
<div class="curated-signature curated-signature--layers" data-story-kind="layers">
<article class="curated-signature__item" style="--story-index:1"><span class="curated-signature__meta">Always visible</span><h3>name + description</h3><p>Discovery metadata tells the model both what the Skill does and when it should be selected.</p></article><article class="curated-signature__item" style="--story-index:2"><span class="curated-signature__meta">After trigger</span><h3>SKILL.md</h3><p>The decision procedure enters context only after the trigger has matched.</p></article><article class="curated-signature__item" style="--story-index:3"><span class="curated-signature__meta">On demand</span><h3>scripts / references / assets</h3><p>Deterministic work, optional knowledge, and output material remain outside the main prompt until referenced or executed.</p></article>
</div>
<div class="curated-story__evidence"><span>Evidence</span><a href="https://github.com/anthropics/skills/blob/f17010c9bb483898c1d9c9f42dde2b3a98889434/template/SKILL.md" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Basic Skill template<svg class="curated-icon" aria-hidden="true" viewBox="0 0 24 24" data-icon="lucide:external"><path fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M15 3h6v6m-11 5L21 3m-3 10v6a2 2 0 0 1-2 2H5a2 2 0 0 1-2-2V8a2 2 0 0 1 2-2h6"/></svg></a><a href="https://github.com/anthropics/skills/blob/f17010c9bb483898c1d9c9f42dde2b3a98889434/skills/skill-creator/SKILL.md#test-cases" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Skill creator<svg class="curated-icon" aria-hidden="true" viewBox="0 0 24 24" data-icon="lucide:external"><path fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M15 3h6v6m-11 5L21 3m-3 10v6a2 2 0 0 1-2 2H5a2 2 0 0 1-2-2V8a2 2 0 0 1 2-2h6"/></svg></a></div>
</section>
<section class="curated-story__section" aria-labelledby="project-mechanisms">
<h2 id="project-mechanisms">What the repository teaches about Skill design</h2>
<div class="curated-story__mechanisms">
<article><h3>Three context levels</h3><p>Discovery metadata is always visible, SKILL.md loads only after a trigger, and bundled resources enter context or execute only when needed.</p></article><article><h3>Behavior is evaluated against a baseline</h3><p>skill-creator runs realistic prompts with and without the Skill, grades assertions and outputs, records cost and timing, and presents human review.</p></article><article><h3>Minimal and production-heavy examples</h3><p>A tiny template sits beside script- and asset-heavy document workflows used by Claude, exposing both packaging extremes and their license boundary.</p></article>
</div>
</section>
<section class="curated-story__section" aria-labelledby="project-practice">
<h2 id="project-practice">Evaluate behavior before polishing prose</h2>
<ol class="curated-story__practice">
<li><p>Start with the template and make the description say both what the skill does and when it should trigger.</p></li><li><p>Keep the main procedure in SKILL.md; move repeatable operations, optional knowledge, and output material into scripts, references, and assets.</p></li><li><p>Diagnose trigger failures separately from output failures: tune description with trigger evals, and tune the body with task assertions and human review.</p></li>
</ol>
</section>
<section class="curated-story__section" aria-labelledby="adoption-decision">
<h2 id="adoption-decision">Use it as a reference library, not a process owner</h2>
<div class="curated-story__decision">
<div>
<h3>Useful when</h3>
<p>Learning Agent Skill anatomy, creating a new Claude skill, or studying mature document and workflow examples.</p>
</div>
<div>
<h3>Do not assume</h3>
<p>Anthropic describes most entries as demonstration and educational material. Test them in your own environment; some document skills are source-available rather than open source.</p>
</div>
</div>
</section>
<section class="curated-story__section curated-story__sources" aria-labelledby="reviewed-sources">
<h2 id="reviewed-sources">Sources reviewed</h2>
<p><code>f17010c</code></p>
<ul>
<li><a href="https://github.com/anthropics/skills/blob/f17010c9bb483898c1d9c9f42dde2b3a98889434/README.md#about-this-repository" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Repository overview<svg class="curated-icon" aria-hidden="true" viewBox="0 0 24 24" data-icon="lucide:external"><path fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M15 3h6v6m-11 5L21 3m-3 10v6a2 2 0 0 1-2 2H5a2 2 0 0 1-2-2V8a2 2 0 0 1 2-2h6"/></svg></a></li><li><a href="https://github.com/anthropics/skills/blob/f17010c9bb483898c1d9c9f42dde2b3a98889434/template/SKILL.md" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Basic Skill template<svg class="curated-icon" aria-hidden="true" viewBox="0 0 24 24" data-icon="lucide:external"><path fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M15 3h6v6m-11 5L21 3m-3 10v6a2 2 0 0 1-2 2H5a2 2 0 0 1-2-2V8a2 2 0 0 1 2-2h6"/></svg></a></li><li><a href="https://github.com/anthropics/skills/blob/f17010c9bb483898c1d9c9f42dde2b3a98889434/skills/skill-creator/SKILL.md#test-cases" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Skill creator<svg class="curated-icon" aria-hidden="true" viewBox="0 0 24 24" data-icon="lucide:external"><path fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M15 3h6v6m-11 5L21 3m-3 10v6a2 2 0 0 1-2 2H5a2 2 0 0 1-2-2V8a2 2 0 0 1 2-2h6"/></svg></a></li>

# gstack

A role-based Claude Code operating system that carries product intent through planning, browser QA, release, deployment, and documentation.

Page: https://skills.lencx.me/collections/gstack/
Markdown: https://skills.lencx.me/collections/gstack/index.md

<div class="curated-detail curated-card--gstack">
<div class="curated-detail__identity">
<span class="curated-card__avatar-frame" aria-hidden="true"><img class="curated-card__avatar curated-card__avatar--fallback" src="/github-placeholder.svg" alt="" width="96" height="96"><img class="curated-card__avatar curated-card__avatar--remote" data-github-avatar src="https://avatars.githubusercontent.com/u/19957?v=4&amp;s=96" alt="" width="96" height="96" loading="lazy" decoding="async" referrerpolicy="no-referrer"></span>
<div class="curated-detail__identity-copy">
<a class="curated-detail__repository" href="https://github.com/garrytan/gstack" target="_blank" rel="noopener" aria-label="View GitHub repository: gstack">garrytan/gstack</a>
<div class="curated-detail__tags" aria-label="Project tags"><a href="/collections/?tag=engineering" title="Filter by tag: #Engineering">#Engineering</a><a href="/collections/?tag=design" title="Filter by tag: #Design">#Design</a><a href="/collections/?tag=delivery" title="Filter by tag: #Delivery">#Delivery</a></div>

<dl class="curated-detail__stats" aria-label="GitHub snapshot">
<div><dt><svg class="curated-icon" aria-hidden="true" viewBox="0 0 24 24" data-icon="lucide:star"><path fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M11.525 2.295a.53.53 0 0 1 .95 0l2.31 4.679a2.12 2.12 0 0 0 1.595 1.16l5.166.756a.53.53 0 0 1 .294.904l-3.736 3.638a2.12 2.12 0 0 0-.611 1.878l.882 5.14a.53.53 0 0 1-.771.56l-4.618-2.428a2.12 2.12 0 0 0-1.973 0L6.396 21.01a.53.53 0 0 1-.77-.56l.881-5.139a2.12 2.12 0 0 0-.611-1.879L2.16 9.795a.53.53 0 0 1 .294-.906l5.165-.755a2.12 2.12 0 0 0 1.597-1.16z"/></svg><span>Stars</span></dt><dd title="127,596">127,596</dd></div>
<div><dt><svg class="curated-icon" aria-hidden="true" viewBox="0 0 24 24" data-icon="lucide:fork"><g fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2"><circle cx="12" cy="18" r="3"/><circle cx="6" cy="6" r="3"/><circle cx="18" cy="6" r="3"/><path d="M18 9v2c0 .6-.4 1-1 1H7c-.6 0-1-.4-1-1V9m6 3v3"/></g></svg><span>Forks</span></dt><dd title="19,216">19,216</dd></div>

<a class="curated-detail__repo" href="https://github.com/garrytan/gstack" target="_blank" rel="noopener"><svg class="curated-icon" aria-hidden="true" viewBox="0 0 24 24" data-icon="lucide:github"><g fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2"><path d="M15 22v-4a4.8 4.8 0 0 0-1-3.5c3.28-.36 6.72-1.61 6.72-7.25A5.65 5.65 0 0 0 19.22 3.3A5.27 5.27 0 0 0 19.08.32S17.9-.06 15 1.82a13.38 13.38 0 0 0-7 0C5.1-.06 3.92.32 3.92.32A5.27 5.27 0 0 0 3.78 3.3a5.65 5.65 0 0 0-1.5 3.95c0 5.64 3.44 6.89 6.72 7.25A4.8 4.8 0 0 0 8 18v4"/><path d="M9 18c-4.51 2-5-2-7-2"/></g></svg><span>View GitHub repository</span></a>
</div>
<p class="curated-detail__snapshot"><span>Analysis revision <code>94993f7</code></span><span aria-hidden="true">·</span><span>GitHub snapshot Aug 12, 2026</span><span aria-hidden="true">·</span><span>Metrics are a dated GitHub snapshot and are not used as a quality score.</span></p>
<div class="curated-story">
<div class="curated-story__lede">
<p class="curated-story__thesis">gstack behaves less like a loose Skill catalog and more like a command-driven startup team. Artifacts travel from product interrogation through real browser QA, deployment health, release documentation, and reflection.</p>
<p>The linked sprint is Think → Plan → Build → Review → Test → Ship → Reflect. Commands adopt distinct organizational roles, while artifacts from office-hours and plan reviews feed downstream engineering, browser QA, release, deployment, canary, and documentation stages. Several stages can mutate code, commit, push, open or merge PRs, and deploy.</p>
</div>
<section class="curated-story__section curated-story__signature" aria-labelledby="signature-model">
<header class="curated-story__section-heading">
<h2 id="signature-model">The linked sprint, end to end</h2>
<p>The important distinction is artifact flow. Upstream product and plan decisions become inputs to engineering, QA, release, and operations instead of being discarded after a chat.</p>
</header>
<div class="curated-signature curated-signature--sprint" data-story-kind="sprint">
<article class="curated-signature__item" style="--story-index:1"><span class="curated-signature__meta">Think</span><h3>office-hours</h3><p>Interrogate the problem, user, and product thesis.</p></article><article class="curated-signature__item" style="--story-index:2"><span class="curated-signature__meta">Plan</span><h3>Executive reviews</h3><p>CEO, engineering, design, DX, and security lenses challenge different assumptions.</p></article><article class="curated-signature__item" style="--story-index:3"><span class="curated-signature__meta">Build</span><h3>Implementation</h3><p>Approved artifacts guide the code change.</p></article><article class="curated-signature__item" style="--story-index:4"><span class="curated-signature__meta">Review</span><h3>Static and independent review</h3><p>Review code and optionally bring in a second model.</p></article><article class="curated-signature__item" style="--story-index:5"><span class="curated-signature__meta">Test</span><h3>Browser QA</h3><p>Reproduce, fix, rerun, and add regression evidence in Chromium.</p></article><article class="curated-signature__item" style="--story-index:6"><span class="curated-signature__meta">Ship</span><h3>PR → deploy → canary</h3><p>Carry the result through CI, production, and post-deploy health.</p></article><article class="curated-signature__item" style="--story-index:7"><span class="curated-signature__meta">Reflect</span><h3>Docs and retrospective</h3><p>Detect stale documentation and feed lessons into the next sprint.</p></article>
</div>
<div class="curated-story__evidence"><span>Evidence</span><a href="https://github.com/garrytan/gstack/blob/94993f74012782fd94416dd44b8314f6363a13a4/README.md#L171-L235" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Sprint and role pipeline<svg class="curated-icon" aria-hidden="true" viewBox="0 0 24 24" data-icon="lucide:external"><path fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M15 3h6v6m-11 5L21 3m-3 10v6a2 2 0 0 1-2 2H5a2 2 0 0 1-2-2V8a2 2 0 0 1 2-2h6"/></svg></a><a href="https://github.com/garrytan/gstack/blob/94993f74012782fd94416dd44b8314f6363a13a4/docs/skills.md" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Skill deep dives<svg class="curated-icon" aria-hidden="true" viewBox="0 0 24 24" data-icon="lucide:external"><path fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M15 3h6v6m-11 5L21 3m-3 10v6a2 2 0 0 1-2 2H5a2 2 0 0 1-2-2V8a2 2 0 0 1 2-2h6"/></svg></a></div>
</section>
<section class="curated-story__section" aria-labelledby="project-mechanisms">
<h2 id="project-mechanisms">Where the sprint goes beyond coding</h2>
<div class="curated-story__mechanisms">
<article><h3>Browser-in-the-loop QA</h3><p>QA drives real Chromium, records defects, fixes them with atomic commits, reruns the failing path, and adds regression tests; qa-only keeps the investigation read-only.</p></article><article><h3>Release work continues after review</h3><p>Ship audits tests and coverage before opening a PR; land-and-deploy waits for CI and deployment, canary observes production, and document-release catches stale docs.</p></article><article><h3>Planning uses distinct executive lenses</h3><p>CEO, engineering, design, DX, and security reviews challenge different assumptions instead of collapsing every concern into one generic planning prompt.</p></article>
</div>
</section>
<section class="curated-story__section" aria-labelledby="project-practice">
<h2 id="project-practice">A low-risk way to evaluate the system</h2>
<ol class="curated-story__practice">
<li><p>Evaluate it with office-hours → plan-ceo-review → review → qa before adopting the entire sprint.</p></li><li><p>Use qa-only or other report-only modes until code changes, commits, pushes, and deployment actions are explicitly authorized.</p></li><li><p>Enable guard for production incidents or any task whose editable subtree must stay narrow.</p></li>
</ol>
</section>
<section class="curated-story__section" aria-labelledby="adoption-decision">
<h2 id="adoption-decision">Separate report-only use from delivery authority</h2>
<div class="curated-story__decision">
<div>
<h3>Best suited to</h3>
<p>Technical founders and small teams that want one Claude Code environment to cover product framing, implementation review, live QA, release, deployment, documentation, and retrospectives.</p>
</div>
<div>
<h3>Authority boundary</h3>
<p>The primary experience is Claude Code, setup can modify global or committed agent state, and many commands are high-authority mutations. The About text says 23 tools, but the current tree evolves quickly; treat that number as reviewed copy, not a live inventory.</p>
</div>
</div>
</section>
<section class="curated-story__section curated-story__sources" aria-labelledby="reviewed-sources">
<h2 id="reviewed-sources">Sources reviewed</h2>
<p><code>94993f7</code></p>
<ul>
<li><a href="https://github.com/garrytan/gstack/blob/94993f74012782fd94416dd44b8314f6363a13a4/README.md#L171-L235" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Sprint and role pipeline<svg class="curated-icon" aria-hidden="true" viewBox="0 0 24 24" data-icon="lucide:external"><path fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M15 3h6v6m-11 5L21 3m-3 10v6a2 2 0 0 1-2 2H5a2 2 0 0 1-2-2V8a2 2 0 0 1 2-2h6"/></svg></a></li><li><a href="https://github.com/garrytan/gstack/blob/94993f74012782fd94416dd44b8314f6363a13a4/docs/skills.md" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Skill deep dives<svg class="curated-icon" aria-hidden="true" viewBox="0 0 24 24" data-icon="lucide:external"><path fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M15 3h6v6m-11 5L21 3m-3 10v6a2 2 0 0 1-2 2H5a2 2 0 0 1-2-2V8a2 2 0 0 1 2-2h6"/></svg></a></li><li><a href="https://github.com/garrytan/gstack/blob/94993f74012782fd94416dd44b8314f6363a13a4/README.md#L444-L456" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Privacy and telemetry<svg class="curated-icon" aria-hidden="true" viewBox="0 0 24 24" data-icon="lucide:external"><path fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M15 3h6v6m-11 5L21 3m-3 10v6a2 2 0 0 1-2 2H5a2 2 0 0 1-2-2V8a2 2 0 0 1 2-2h6"/></svg></a></li>

# Impeccable

Design guidance and practical commands that help AI coding agents shape, critique, audit, and refine frontend experiences.

Page: https://skills.lencx.me/collections/impeccable/
Markdown: https://skills.lencx.me/collections/impeccable/index.md

<div class="curated-detail curated-card--impeccable">
<div class="curated-detail__identity">
<span class="curated-card__avatar-frame" aria-hidden="true"><img class="curated-card__avatar curated-card__avatar--fallback" src="/github-placeholder.svg" alt="" width="96" height="96"><img class="curated-card__avatar curated-card__avatar--remote" data-github-avatar src="https://avatars.githubusercontent.com/u/43004?u=a2129579fad3fa98301c2d64da926bbb5fb6b129&amp;v=4&amp;s=96" alt="" width="96" height="96" loading="lazy" decoding="async" referrerpolicy="no-referrer"></span>
<div class="curated-detail__identity-copy">
<a class="curated-detail__repository" href="https://github.com/pbakaus/impeccable" target="_blank" rel="noopener" aria-label="View GitHub repository: Impeccable">pbakaus/impeccable</a>
<div class="curated-detail__tags" aria-label="Project tags"><a href="/collections/?tag=design" title="Filter by tag: #Design">#Design</a><a href="/collections/?tag=quality" title="Filter by tag: #Quality">#Quality</a></div>
</div>
</div>
<dl class="curated-detail__stats" aria-label="GitHub snapshot">
<div><dt><svg class="curated-icon" aria-hidden="true" viewBox="0 0 24 24" data-icon="lucide:star"><path fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M11.525 2.295a.53.53 0 0 1 .95 0l2.31 4.679a2.12 2.12 0 0 0 1.595 1.16l5.166.756a.53.53 0 0 1 .294.904l-3.736 3.638a2.12 2.12 0 0 0-.611 1.878l.882 5.14a.53.53 0 0 1-.771.56l-4.618-2.428a2.12 2.12 0 0 0-1.973 0L6.396 21.01a.53.53 0 0 1-.77-.56l.881-5.139a2.12 2.12 0 0 0-.611-1.879L2.16 9.795a.53.53 0 0 1 .294-.906l5.165-.755a2.12 2.12 0 0 0 1.597-1.16z"/></svg><span>Stars</span></dt><dd title="58,314">58,314</dd></div>
<div><dt><svg class="curated-icon" aria-hidden="true" viewBox="0 0 24 24" data-icon="lucide:fork"><g fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2"><circle cx="12" cy="18" r="3"/><circle cx="6" cy="6" r="3"/><circle cx="18" cy="6" r="3"/><path d="M18 9v2c0 .6-.4 1-1 1H7c-.6 0-1-.4-1-1V9m6 3v3"/></g></svg><span>Forks</span></dt><dd title="3,558">3,558</dd></div>
</dl>
<a class="curated-detail__repo" href="https://github.com/pbakaus/impeccable" target="_blank" rel="noopener"><svg class="curated-icon" aria-hidden="true" viewBox="0 0 24 24" data-icon="lucide:github"><g fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2"><path d="M15 22v-4a4.8 4.8 0 0 0-1-3.5c3.28-.36 6.72-1.61 6.72-7.25A5.65 5.65 0 0 0 19.22 3.3A5.27 5.27 0 0 0 19.08.32S17.9-.06 15 1.82a13.38 13.38 0 0 0-7 0C5.1-.06 3.92.32 3.92.32A5.27 5.27 0 0 0 3.78 3.3a5.65 5.65 0 0 0-1.5 3.95c0 5.64 3.44 6.89 6.72 7.25A4.8 4.8 0 0 0 8 18v4"/><path d="M9 18c-4.51 2-5-2-7-2"/></g></svg><span>View GitHub repository</span></a>
</div>
<p class="curated-detail__snapshot"><span>Analysis revision <code>ae388ac</code></span><span aria-hidden="true">·</span><span>GitHub snapshot Aug 12, 2026</span><span aria-hidden="true">·</span><span>Metrics are a dated GitHub snapshot and are not used as a quality score.</span></p>
<div class="curated-story">
<div class="curated-story__lede">
<p class="curated-story__thesis">Impeccable turns design into a system of authorities and rendered evidence. It is not a collection of prompts that merely asks an agent to make a page look better.</p>
<p>A session starts by resolving PRODUCT.md, DESIGN.md, the matching surface brief, and platform guidance. It then loads exactly one command playbook, and loads a separate craft floor immediately before UI edits. Deterministic detector rules and live browser variants supply evidence that model-only critique cannot.</p>
</div>
<section class="curated-story__section curated-story__signature" aria-labelledby="signature-model">
<header class="curated-story__section-heading">
<h2 id="signature-model">The authority stack behind each UI change</h2>
<p>Each layer answers a different question. Keeping them separate lets a redesign replace visual direction without rewriting product truth, and lets mechanical checks support rather than impersonate design judgment.</p>
</header>
<div class="curated-signature curated-signature--authority-stack" data-story-kind="authority-stack">
<article class="curated-signature__item" style="--story-index:1"><span class="curated-signature__meta">Product truth</span><h3>PRODUCT.md</h3><p>Users, jobs, evidence, operating context, constraints, and accessibility stay durable.</p></article><article class="curated-signature__item" style="--story-index:2"><span class="curated-signature__meta">Visual truth</span><h3>DESIGN.md + surface brief</h3><p>The product-wide visual world and the decisions unique to one surface remain distinct.</p></article><article class="curated-signature__item" style="--story-index:3"><span class="curated-signature__meta">One judgment</span><h3>Command playbook</h3><p>critique, audit, polish, harden, and other commands load only the method needed for the current task.</p></article><article class="curated-signature__item" style="--story-index:4"><span class="curated-signature__meta">Before editing</span><h3>Craft floor</h3><p>A separate quality floor constrains typography, contrast, spacing, iconography, and common design shortcuts.</p></article><article class="curated-signature__item" style="--story-index:5"><span class="curated-signature__meta">Rendered evidence</span><h3>Detector + live browser</h3><p>Deterministic rules catch mechanical defects; live mode compares real rendered alternatives.</p></article>
</div>
<div class="curated-story__evidence"><span>Evidence</span><a href="https://github.com/pbakaus/impeccable/blob/ae388ac58fb33aade50fc47e2be07c3192dcaabd/README.md#why-impeccable" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Why Impeccable<svg class="curated-icon" aria-hidden="true" viewBox="0 0 24 24" data-icon="lucide:external"><path fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M15 3h6v6m-11 5L21 3m-3 10v6a2 2 0 0 1-2 2H5a2 2 0 0 1-2-2V8a2 2 0 0 1 2-2h6"/></svg></a><a href="https://github.com/pbakaus/impeccable/blob/ae388ac58fb33aade50fc47e2be07c3192dcaabd/.agents/skills/impeccable/SKILL.md#setup" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Commands and examples<svg class="curated-icon" aria-hidden="true" viewBox="0 0 24 24" data-icon="lucide:external"><path fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M15 3h6v6m-11 5L21 3m-3 10v6a2 2 0 0 1-2 2H5a2 2 0 0 1-2-2V8a2 2 0 0 1 2-2h6"/></svg></a><a href="https://github.com/pbakaus/impeccable/blob/ae388ac58fb33aade50fc47e2be07c3192dcaabd/.agents/skills/impeccable/reference/live.md" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Live browser iteration<svg class="curated-icon" aria-hidden="true" viewBox="0 0 24 24" data-icon="lucide:external"><path fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M15 3h6v6m-11 5L21 3m-3 10v6a2 2 0 0 1-2 2H5a2 2 0 0 1-2-2V8a2 2 0 0 1 2-2h6"/></svg></a></div>
</section>
<section class="curated-story__section" aria-labelledby="project-mechanisms">
<h2 id="project-mechanisms">Where the method is more specific than “good design”</h2>
<div class="curated-story__mechanisms">
<article><h3>Product truth and visual direction stay separate</h3><p>A redesign may replace the visual world while preserving users, product purpose, evidence, content, and constraints recorded as product truth.</p></article><article><h3>Commands own different judgments</h3><p>critique evaluates experience quality, audit checks technical quality, polish closes shipping gaps, and harden covers errors, i18n, overflow, and edge cases.</p></article><article><h3>Tool-backed rendered evidence</h3><p>Detectors catch mechanical defects, while live mode operates a real preview with selected elements, alternatives, annotations, and accept or reject actions.</p></article>
</div>
</section>
<section class="curated-story__section" aria-labelledby="project-practice">
<h2 id="project-practice">Choose the command by the judgment you need</h2>
<ol class="curated-story__practice">
<li><p>Run impeccable init before other commands so later work has real brand and product context.</p></li><li><p>Pair a command with a concrete target, such as audit the blog, polish settings, or harden checkout.</p></li><li><p>Use critique for experience judgment and audit for deterministic technical checks; do not treat them as interchangeable.</p></li>
</ol>
</section>
<section class="curated-story__section" aria-labelledby="adoption-decision">
<h2 id="adoption-decision">Adopt the method without leaking private context</h2>
<div class="curated-story__decision">
<div>
<h3>Use it for</h3>
<p>Landing pages, portfolios, application UI, and dashboards that need shaping, UX critique, technical audit, or final polish.</p>
</div>
<div>
<h3>Review before sharing</h3>
<p>Installation can add project hooks. Codex users should review and approve them, and may need to approve again after hook definitions change.</p>
</div>
</div>
</section>
<section class="curated-story__section curated-story__sources" aria-labelledby="reviewed-sources">

# Matt Pocock’s Skills

A collection of small, adaptable, composable skills for everyday software engineering workflows.

Page: https://skills.lencx.me/collections/matt-pocock-skills/
Markdown: https://skills.lencx.me/collections/matt-pocock-skills/index.md

<div class="curated-detail curated-card--matt">
<div class="curated-detail__identity">
<span class="curated-card__avatar-frame" aria-hidden="true"><img class="curated-card__avatar curated-card__avatar--fallback" src="/github-placeholder.svg" alt="" width="96" height="96"><img class="curated-card__avatar curated-card__avatar--remote" data-github-avatar src="https://avatars.githubusercontent.com/u/28293365?u=0d66fa0a2c0a4ec5201818081308c14a43b72fe5&amp;v=4&amp;s=96" alt="" width="96" height="96" loading="lazy" decoding="async" referrerpolicy="no-referrer"></span>

<div class="curated-detail__tags" aria-label="Project tags"><a href="/collections/?tag=engineering" title="Filter by tag: #Engineering">#Engineering</a><a href="/collections/?tag=delivery" title="Filter by tag: #Delivery">#Delivery</a></div>

<div><dt><svg class="curated-icon" aria-hidden="true" viewBox="0 0 24 24" data-icon="lucide:fork"><g fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2"><circle cx="12" cy="18" r="3"/><circle cx="6" cy="6" r="3"/><circle cx="18" cy="6" r="3"/><path d="M18 9v2c0 .6-.4 1-1 1H7c-.6 0-1-.4-1-1V9m6 3v3"/></g></svg><span>Forks</span></dt><dd title="18,468">18,468</dd></div>
</dl>
<a class="curated-detail__repo" href="https://github.com/mattpocock/skills" target="_blank" rel="noopener"><svg class="curated-icon" aria-hidden="true" viewBox="0 0 24 24" data-icon="lucide:github"><g fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2"><path d="M15 22v-4a4.8 4.8 0 0 0-1-3.5c3.28-.36 6.72-1.61 6.72-7.25A5.65 5.65 0 0 0 19.22 3.3A5.27 5.27 0 0 0 19.08.32S17.9-.06 15 1.82a13.38 13.38 0 0 0-7 0C5.1-.06 3.92.32 3.92.32A5.27 5.27 0 0 0 3.78 3.3a5.65 5.65 0 0 0-1.5 3.95c0 5.64 3.44 6.89 6.72 7.25A4.8 4.8 0 0 0 8 18v4"/><path d="M9 18c-4.51 2-5-2-7-2"/></g></svg><span>View GitHub repository</span></a>
</div>
<p class="curated-detail__snapshot"><span>Analysis revision <code>84fdeff</code></span><span aria-hidden="true">·</span><span>GitHub snapshot Aug 12, 2026</span><span aria-hidden="true">·</span><span>Metrics are a dated GitHub snapshot and are not used as a quality score.</span></p>
<div class="curated-story">
<div class="curated-story__lede">
<p class="curated-story__thesis">This collection deliberately refuses to become one universal lifecycle. Explicit orchestrators compose work; automatically selected Skills contribute one engineering discipline; repository setup keeps both aligned with local conventions.</p>
<p>User-invoked Skills such as grill-with-docs and implement orchestrate a flow; model-invoked Skills such as diagnosis, TDD, research, and code review contribute one reusable discipline. A repository setup step first records the issue tracker, triage labels, and domain-context or ADR locations that later workflows must follow.</p>
</div>
<section class="curated-story__section curated-story__signature" aria-labelledby="signature-model">
<header class="curated-story__section-heading">
<h2 id="signature-model">Three responsibilities that must not blur together</h2>
<p>The most important design choice is the invocation boundary. It prevents an automatically triggered helper from silently taking over an entire engineering process.</p>
</header>
<div class="curated-signature curated-signature--roles" data-story-kind="roles">
<article class="curated-signature__item" style="--story-index:1"><span class="curated-signature__meta">User-invoked</span><h3>Orchestrators</h3><p>grill-with-docs, to-spec, and implement own an explicit flow requested by the user.</p></article><article class="curated-signature__item" style="--story-index:2"><span class="curated-signature__meta">Model-invoked</span><h3>Disciplines</h3><p>Diagnosis, TDD, research, domain modeling, and review each supply one reusable method.</p></article><article class="curated-signature__item" style="--story-index:3"><span class="curated-signature__meta">Repository-owned</span><h3>Setup contracts</h3><p>Tracker choice, triage vocabulary, and CONTEXT.md or ADR locations are recorded before later workflows depend on them.</p></article>
</div>
<div class="curated-story__evidence"><span>Evidence</span><a href="https://github.com/mattpocock/skills/blob/84fdeffd12f2ee307994d1eb6feb48173b6e0502/README.md#reference" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Repository overview<svg class="curated-icon" aria-hidden="true" viewBox="0 0 24 24" data-icon="lucide:external"><path fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M15 3h6v6m-11 5L21 3m-3 10v6a2 2 0 0 1-2 2H5a2 2 0 0 1-2-2V8a2 2 0 0 1 2-2h6"/></svg></a><a href="https://github.com/mattpocock/skills/blob/84fdeffd12f2ee307994d1eb6feb48173b6e0502/skills/engineering/setup-matt-pocock-skills/SKILL.md#process" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Repository setup<svg class="curated-icon" aria-hidden="true" viewBox="0 0 24 24" data-icon="lucide:external"><path fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M15 3h6v6m-11 5L21 3m-3 10v6a2 2 0 0 1-2 2H5a2 2 0 0 1-2-2V8a2 2 0 0 1 2-2h6"/></svg></a></div>
</section>
<section class="curated-story__section" aria-labelledby="project-mechanisms">
<h2 id="project-mechanisms">Engineering ideas worth borrowing independently</h2>
<div class="curated-story__mechanisms">
<article><h3>Domain language becomes repository state</h3><p>grill-with-docs sharpens terms in CONTEXT.md and records consequential decisions in ADRs so later sessions share the codebase’s nouns.</p></article><article><h3>Diagnosis starts with a red-capable command</h3><p>The diagnosing Skill refuses to theorize until one unattended command reproduces the exact symptom, then minimizes it and tests falsifiable hypotheses.</p></article><article><h3>Architecture uses a precise module vocabulary</h3><p>codebase-design looks for deep modules—substantial behavior behind a small interface—at explicit, testable seams instead of proposing broad rewrites.</p></article>
</div>
</section>
<section class="curated-story__section" aria-labelledby="project-practice">
<h2 id="project-practice">Start with repository setup, then pick one discipline</h2>
<ol class="curated-story__practice">
<li><p>Choose either the managed Claude plugin or editable skills.sh installation; installing both duplicates the skills.</p></li><li><p>Run the repository setup once so issue tracking, labels, and domain-document locations are explicit.</p></li><li><p>For a difficult bug, make the exact symptom fail from one fast command before ranking three to five falsifiable hypotheses.</p></li>
</ol>
</section>
<section class="curated-story__section" aria-labelledby="adoption-decision">
<h2 id="adoption-decision">Choose modular control over a single lifecycle</h2>
<div class="curated-story__decision">
<div>
<h3>Strong fit for</h3>
<p>Repositories that need better specification, domain modeling, work breakdown, TDD, difficult bug diagnosis, or code review.</p>
</div>
<div>
<h3>Setup cost</h3>
<p>The engineering workflows expect repository-level setup. Without tracker, label, and documentation conventions, their defaults can drift from the project.</p>
</div>
</div>
</section>
<section class="curated-story__section curated-story__sources" aria-labelledby="reviewed-sources">
<h2 id="reviewed-sources">Sources reviewed</h2>

<ul>
<li><a href="https://github.com/mattpocock/skills/blob/84fdeffd12f2ee307994d1eb6feb48173b6e0502/README.md#reference" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Repository overview<svg class="curated-icon" aria-hidden="true" viewBox="0 0 24 24" data-icon="lucide:external"><path fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M15 3h6v6m-11 5L21 3m-3 10v6a2 2 0 0 1-2 2H5a2 2 0 0 1-2-2V8a2 2 0 0 1 2-2h6"/></svg></a></li><li><a href="https://github.com/mattpocock/skills/blob/84fdeffd12f2ee307994d1eb6feb48173b6e0502/skills/engineering/diagnosing-bugs/SKILL.md#phase-1--build-a-feedback-loop" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Skill reference<svg class="curated-icon" aria-hidden="true" viewBox="0 0 24 24" data-icon="lucide:external"><path fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M15 3h6v6m-11 5L21 3m-3 10v6a2 2 0 0 1-2 2H5a2 2 0 0 1-2-2V8a2 2 0 0 1 2-2h6"/></svg></a></li><li><a href="https://github.com/mattpocock/skills/blob/84fdeffd12f2ee307994d1eb6feb48173b6e0502/skills/engineering/setup-matt-pocock-skills/SKILL.md#process" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Repository setup<svg class="curated-icon" aria-hidden="true" viewBox="0 0 24 24" data-icon="lucide:external"><path fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M15 3h6v6m-11 5L21 3m-3 10v6a2 2 0 0 1-2 2H5a2 2 0 0 1-2-2V8a2 2 0 0 1 2-2h6"/></svg></a></li>

# Superpowers

A software development methodology built from composable skills for design, planning, testing, review, and delivery.

Page: https://skills.lencx.me/collections/superpowers/
Markdown: https://skills.lencx.me/collections/superpowers/index.md

<div class="curated-detail curated-card--superpowers">
<div class="curated-detail__identity">
<span class="curated-card__avatar-frame" aria-hidden="true"><img class="curated-card__avatar curated-card__avatar--fallback" src="/github-placeholder.svg" alt="" width="96" height="96"><img class="curated-card__avatar curated-card__avatar--remote" data-github-avatar src="https://avatars.githubusercontent.com/u/45416?u=37d9e6e1ec50898b8c0b4005613538db1f7a4167&amp;v=4&amp;s=96" alt="" width="96" height="96" loading="lazy" decoding="async" referrerpolicy="no-referrer"></span>
<div class="curated-detail__identity-copy">
<a class="curated-detail__repository" href="https://github.com/obra/superpowers" target="_blank" rel="noopener" aria-label="View GitHub repository: Superpowers">obra/superpowers</a>
<div class="curated-detail__tags" aria-label="Project tags"><a href="/collections/?tag=engineering" title="Filter by tag: #Engineering">#Engineering</a><a href="/collections/?tag=delivery" title="Filter by tag: #Delivery">#Delivery</a><a href="/collections/?tag=quality" title="Filter by tag: #Quality">#Quality</a></div>
</div>
</div>
<dl class="curated-detail__stats" aria-label="GitHub snapshot">
<div><dt><svg class="curated-icon" aria-hidden="true" viewBox="0 0 24 24" data-icon="lucide:star"><path fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M11.525 2.295a.53.53 0 0 1 .95 0l2.31 4.679a2.12 2.12 0 0 0 1.595 1.16l5.166.756a.53.53 0 0 1 .294.904l-3.736 3.638a2.12 2.12 0 0 0-.611 1.878l.882 5.14a.53.53 0 0 1-.771.56l-4.618-2.428a2.12 2.12 0 0 0-1.973 0L6.396 21.01a.53.53 0 0 1-.77-.56l.881-5.139a2.12 2.12 0 0 0-.611-1.879L2.16 9.795a.53.53 0 0 1 .294-.906l5.165-.755a2.12 2.12 0 0 0 1.597-1.16z"/></svg><span>Stars</span></dt><dd title="270,806">270,806</dd></div>
<div><dt><svg class="curated-icon" aria-hidden="true" viewBox="0 0 24 24" data-icon="lucide:fork"><g fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2"><circle cx="12" cy="18" r="3"/><circle cx="6" cy="6" r="3"/><circle cx="18" cy="6" r="3"/><path d="M18 9v2c0 .6-.4 1-1 1H7c-.6 0-1-.4-1-1V9m6 3v3"/></g></svg><span>Forks</span></dt><dd title="24,194">24,194</dd></div>
</dl>
<a class="curated-detail__repo" href="https://github.com/obra/superpowers" target="_blank" rel="noopener"><svg class="curated-icon" aria-hidden="true" viewBox="0 0 24 24" data-icon="lucide:github"><g fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2"><path d="M15 22v-4a4.8 4.8 0 0 0-1-3.5c3.28-.36 6.72-1.61 6.72-7.25A5.65 5.65 0 0 0 19.22 3.3A5.27 5.27 0 0 0 19.08.32S17.9-.06 15 1.82a13.38 13.38 0 0 0-7 0C5.1-.06 3.92.32 3.92.32A5.27 5.27 0 0 0 3.78 3.3a5.65 5.65 0 0 0-1.5 3.95c0 5.64 3.44 6.89 6.72 7.25A4.8 4.8 0 0 0 8 18v4"/><path d="M9 18c-4.51 2-5-2-7-2"/></g></svg><span>View GitHub repository</span></a>
</div>
<p class="curated-detail__snapshot"><span>Analysis revision <code>44c9b2d</code></span><span aria-hidden="true">·</span><span>GitHub snapshot Aug 12, 2026</span><span aria-hidden="true">·</span><span>Metrics are a dated GitHub snapshot and are not used as a quality score.</span></p>
<div class="curated-story">
<div class="curated-story__lede">
<p class="curated-story__thesis">Installing Superpowers means accepting a development method with hard gates. Design approval, isolation, TDD, separate reviews, and fresh verification are requirements, not optional tips.</p>
<p>Brainstorming and human design approval are hard gates before planning or code. Implementation then moves into an isolated worktree, executes narrow plan tasks with TDD, separates implementer self-review from specification and quality review, and accepts a completion claim only after a freshly run proving command.</p>
</div>
<section class="curated-story__section curated-story__signature" aria-labelledby="signature-model">
<header class="curated-story__section-heading">
<h2 id="signature-model">The path a change must pass before completion</h2>
<p>The sequence matters because each gate creates evidence consumed by the next one. Skipping ahead is treated as a process failure, even when the change looks small.</p>
</header>
<div class="curated-signature curated-signature--hard-gates" data-story-kind="hard-gates">
<article class="curated-signature__item" style="--story-index:1"><h3>Brainstorm</h3><p>Clarify intent and compare approaches.</p></article><article class="curated-signature__item" style="--story-index:2"><h3>Approve design</h3><p>A human accepts the proposed behavior before planning.</p></article><article class="curated-signature__item" style="--story-index:3"><h3>Isolate</h3><p>Use a worktree and establish a clean baseline.</p></article><article class="curated-signature__item" style="--story-index:4"><h3>Plan</h3><p>Write narrow tasks with files and proof commands.</p></article><article class="curated-signature__item" style="--story-index:5"><h3>TDD</h3><p>Implement through red, green, and refactor.</p></article><article class="curated-signature__item" style="--story-index:6"><h3>Review twice</h3><p>Check specification first, then code quality.</p></article><article class="curated-signature__item" style="--story-index:7"><h3>Verify fresh</h3><p>Rerun the proving command immediately before the claim.</p></article>
</div>
<div class="curated-story__evidence"><span>Evidence</span><a href="https://github.com/obra/superpowers/blob/44c9b2d6e889982ac18c27d05a19fefe335194e1/README.md" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Repository overview<svg class="curated-icon" aria-hidden="true" viewBox="0 0 24 24" data-icon="lucide:external"><path fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M15 3h6v6m-11 5L21 3m-3 10v6a2 2 0 0 1-2 2H5a2 2 0 0 1-2-2V8a2 2 0 0 1 2-2h6"/></svg></a><a href="https://github.com/obra/superpowers/blob/44c9b2d6e889982ac18c27d05a19fefe335194e1/skills/brainstorming/SKILL.md#the-process" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Brainstorming workflow<svg class="curated-icon" aria-hidden="true" viewBox="0 0 24 24" data-icon="lucide:external"><path fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M15 3h6v6m-11 5L21 3m-3 10v6a2 2 0 0 1-2 2H5a2 2 0 0 1-2-2V8a2 2 0 0 1 2-2h6"/></svg></a><a href="https://github.com/obra/superpowers/blob/44c9b2d6e889982ac18c27d05a19fefe335194e1/skills/verification-before-completion/SKILL.md#the-iron-law" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Verification before completion<svg class="curated-icon" aria-hidden="true" viewBox="0 0 24 24" data-icon="lucide:external"><path fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M15 3h6v6m-11 5L21 3m-3 10v6a2 2 0 0 1-2 2H5a2 2 0 0 1-2-2V8a2 2 0 0 1 2-2h6"/></svg></a></div>
</section>
<section class="curated-story__section" aria-labelledby="project-mechanisms">
<h2 id="project-mechanisms">Why these gates are load-bearing</h2>
<div class="curated-story__mechanisms">
<article><h3>Design approval is a hard gate</h3><p>Even small behavior changes resolve intent, alternatives, and a readable design before scaffolding, planning, or implementation begins.</p></article><article><h3>Implementation and review are distinct roles</h3><p>Each task is implemented, self-reviewed, checked for specification compliance, checked for code quality, and re-reviewed after fixes.</p></article><article><h3>Verification is temporally fresh</h3><p>A completion claim is invalid unless its proving command was rerun immediately and the complete output and exit status were read.</p></article>
</div>
</section>
<section class="curated-story__section" aria-labelledby="project-practice">
<h2 id="project-practice">Trial the method on one real change</h2>
<ol class="curated-story__practice">
<li><p>Complete brainstorming and design approval before asking the agent to write an implementation plan.</p></li><li><p>Reuse an existing isolated workspace when possible, then run setup and baseline tests before changing code.</p></li><li><p>Follow red, green, refactor and rerun the command that directly proves completion before making the claim.</p></li>
</ol>
</section>
<section class="curated-story__section" aria-labelledby="adoption-decision">
<h2 id="adoption-decision">Adopting it changes how work is approved</h2>
<div class="curated-story__decision">
<div>
<h3>Worth the overhead when</h3>
<p>Feature development or bug fixes that benefit from a rigorous specification, isolated implementation, TDD, subagent collaboration, and review loop.</p>
</div>
<div>
<h3>Process conflict</h3>
<p>Its repository describes the workflows as mandatory rather than optional suggestions. Confirm that this degree of process ownership fits the project’s existing rules.</p>
</div>
</div>
</section>
<section class="curated-story__section curated-story__sources" aria-labelledby="reviewed-sources">
<h2 id="reviewed-sources">Sources reviewed</h2>
<p><code>44c9b2d</code></p>
<ul>
<li><a href="https://github.com/obra/superpowers/blob/44c9b2d6e889982ac18c27d05a19fefe335194e1/README.md" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Repository overview<svg class="curated-icon" aria-hidden="true" viewBox="0 0 24 24" data-icon="lucide:external"><path fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M15 3h6v6m-11 5L21 3m-3 10v6a2 2 0 0 1-2 2H5a2 2 0 0 1-2-2V8a2 2 0 0 1 2-2h6"/></svg></a></li><li><a href="https://github.com/obra/superpowers/blob/44c9b2d6e889982ac18c27d05a19fefe335194e1/skills/brainstorming/SKILL.md#the-process" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Brainstorming workflow<svg class="curated-icon" aria-hidden="true" viewBox="0 0 24 24" data-icon="lucide:external"><path fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M15 3h6v6m-11 5L21 3m-3 10v6a2 2 0 0 1-2 2H5a2 2 0 0 1-2-2V8a2 2 0 0 1 2-2h6"/></svg></a></li><li><a href="https://github.com/obra/superpowers/blob/44c9b2d6e889982ac18c27d05a19fefe335194e1/skills/verification-before-completion/SKILL.md#the-iron-law" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Verification before completion<svg class="curated-icon" aria-hidden="true" viewBox="0 0 24 24" data-icon="lucide:external"><path fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M15 3h6v6m-11 5L21 3m-3 10v6a2 2 0 0 1-2 2H5a2 2 0 0 1-2-2V8a2 2 0 0 1 2-2h6"/></svg></a></li>
</ul>
</section>

# Get started

Install lencx-skills once through the skills installer or a native plugin.

Page: https://skills.lencx.me/get-started/
Markdown: https://skills.lencx.me/get-started/index.md

> Rendered directly from the [canonical source](https://github.com/lencx/skills/blob/main/README.md).

Choose either the skills installer or the native plugin. Using both makes each skill available twice.

## Quick Install (Recommended)

```bash
npx skills@latest add lencx/skills
```

## Specific Install (Global)

```bash
# Claude Code
npx skills@latest add lencx/skills -a claude-code -g

# Codex
npx skills@latest add lencx/skills -a codex -g
```

## Plugin Install

### Codex

```bash
codex plugin marketplace add lencx/skills
codex plugin add lencx-skills@lencx
```

### Claude Code

```bash
claude plugin marketplace add lencx/skills
claude plugin install lencx-skills@lencx
```

## Update Skills

Use the same path you chose for installation.

### Skills Installer

```bash
# Update the selected project or global scope
npx skills@latest update
```

Pass `-p` to update project skills only, or `-g` to update global skills only.

### Native Plugin

```bash
# Codex — refresh the marketplace, then reinstall from it
codex plugin marketplace upgrade lencx
codex plugin add lencx-skills@lencx

# Claude Code — restart Claude Code after the update
claude plugin update lencx-skills@lencx
```

Start a new Codex task, or restart Claude Code, to load the updated plugin.

---

# Skills

Browse the growing lencx-skills collection by responsibility.

Page: https://skills.lencx.me/skills/
Markdown: https://skills.lencx.me/skills/index.md

Each skill declares the work it owns, its applicability boundary, and the point where another workflow should take over.

## Browse the collection

| Skill | Responsibility | Canonical source |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [Keel](/skills/keel/) | Keel discovers, judges, and governs load-bearing arrangements. | [`skills/keel/SKILL.md`](https://github.com/lencx/skills/blob/main/skills/keel/SKILL.md) |
| [Coding Protocol](/skills/coding-protocol/) | A low-friction protocol for reliable repository execution and code-evidence work. | [`skills/coding-protocol/SKILL.md`](https://github.com/lencx/skills/blob/main/skills/coding-protocol/SKILL.md) |

## Combine skills by responsibility

Skills can collaborate without becoming one large process. Let the workflow that owns a judgment make that decision, then hand the authorized work to the workflow that owns execution.

Looking beyond this collection? Browse the [curated skills projects](/collections/) for independent approaches and useful companions.
